stand: Drones have struck Black Sea shipping twice this week: a Turkish-flagged carrier sank near Romania on 5 October, killing two, and Bulgaria's Alfa Watan and Able were hit on 6 October, sinking one and damaging the other. Bulgaria has called off the search for the Alfa Watan's crew, finding no survivors, and says it still cannot determine the drones' origin. Radev calls the attack unacceptable and plans to buy five more air-defence systems. Zelensky says Russia carried it out; opposition accuses Radev of shielding Moscow. Estonia received 13 US drones.

claims.text: A drone strike sank the Turkish-flagged grain carrier Royad Mammadov near Romania, killing two and leaving 11 rescued.
claims.by: Says: Romania's Ministry of Internal Affairs

claims.text: The Romania grain-carrier strike was carried out by two Russian drones.
claims.by: Says: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy; Denies: not addressed by Russia in these articles

claims.text: Drones struck two commercial vessels, the Alfa Watan and the Able, in Bulgaria's Black Sea exclusive economic zone.

The origin of the drones in the Bulgaria attack remains undetermined: no drone wreckage has been recovered, and Radev still will not name an aggressor while opposition figures say it is clearly Russia.
claims.by: Says: Bulgarian authorities (Vice Admiral Rumen Nikolov, PM Rumen Radev); Denies/alleges: opposition figures Assen Vassilev and Ivaylo Mirchev say it is Russia and accuse Radev of shielding it

claims.text: A surviving crew member says the Alfa Watan was hit by a naval mine from underneath, not a drone.
claims.by: Says: unnamed Turkish crew member; Denies: no government confirmation of cause given in these articles

claims.text: NATO's top commander has urged member states to publicly name those they believe responsible for drone incidents once evidence is gathered.
claims.by: Says: NATO Supreme Allied Commander Gen. Alex Grynkewich

claims.text: Germany took almost a month to publicly blame Russia for an August drone-and-explosives attack at Leipzig/Halle Airport.
The US transferred 13 Skydio X10D reconnaissance drones to Estonia's Police and Border Guard Board.
claims.by: Says: US Embassy in Estonia / Ambassador Roman Pipko

claims.text: Zelensky says more than 12 anti-drone turrets have been installed in Kyiv, protecting against Shahed drones.
Zelensky discussed strengthening defences against Russian Shahed drones with Dutch PM Rob Jetten.
Ukraine's Navy says the Bulgaria drone attack, like the Romania strike, was a combined Russian maritime-and-aerial-drone operation.
claims.by: Says: President Volodymyr Zelenskyy, citing Ukraine's Navy; Denies: Russia has not commented on the incident

claims.text: An unnamed maritime security source gave a preliminary assessment that Russia was probably behind the Bulgaria drone attack.
claims.by: Says: unnamed maritime security source cited by Reuters; Denies: Russia did not immediately comment

claims.text: A drone industry expert says the coordinated hitting of two ships travelling in opposite directions points to a Russian escalation.
claims.by: Says: drone manufacturer founder Cameron Chell (Draganfly)

claims.text: Bulgaria's Maritime Search and Rescue Coordination Centre ended its search for the Alfa Watan's missing crew, finding no survivors.
claims.by: Says: Vice Admiral Rumen Nikolov, head of Bulgaria's Maritime Search and Rescue Coordination Centre

claims.text: Bulgaria's government will approve the purchase of five additional surface-to-air missile systems.
EU ambassadors are discussing, in restricted format, a 'nightmare scenario' hybrid attack causing numerous casualties, with talks intensifying since the Leipzig airport drone discovery.

timeline.text: A drone laden with explosives attempted an attack at Leipzig/Halle Airport in Germany.
The US and Estonia signed a transfer agreement for 13 Skydio X10D border-surveillance drones at Tallinn's Miinisadam Naval Base.
A drone strike sank the Turkish-flagged grain carrier Royad Mammadov near Romania's coast; two were killed and 11 rescued.
Zelensky discussed Shahed-drone air defences with Dutch PM Rob Jetten and cited new Kyiv anti-drone turrets.
Drones struck two commercial vessels in Bulgaria's exclusive economic zone around 3 a.m.; the Alfa Watan sank and the Able caught fire.
PM Rumen Radev called the strike a blatant violation of international law after an emergency government meeting, without naming an aggressor.
Acting President Iliana Iotova signed a decree to convene Bulgaria's security council on Wednesday (7 Oct).
Opposition figures accused Radev of avoiding naming Russia as the aggressor out of sympathy for the Kremlin.
Zelensky said Ukraine's Navy had established the Bulgaria strike as a combined Russian maritime-and-aerial-drone attack, after contacting Bulgarian counterparts.
A Reuters maritime security source said a preliminary assessment pointed to Russia as the likely attacker in Bulgaria's waters.
European Commission President Ursula von der Leyen condemned the targeting of commercial ships and crews.
Hungarian PM Peter Magyar voiced solidarity with Bulgaria after the attack on the two ships.
Bulgaria's Security Council is set to meet at 13:00 at the presidential residence on maritime security and critical-infrastructure risks.
Bulgaria's Maritime Search and Rescue Coordination Centre ended the search for the Alfa Watan's missing crew; no drone wreckage was recovered, only a boat, life rafts and ship debris.
Radev announced his government would approve the purchase of five additional surface-to-air missile systems.
Politico reported EU ambassadors have been discussing a 'nightmare scenario' hybrid-attack contingency plan since the August Leipzig drone discovery.
Romania scrambled F-16 fighter jets to destroy a maritime drone near the Neptun Deep gas platform in the Black Sea.
NATO's Gen. Alex Grynkewich urged member states to publicly identify those responsible for drone incidents once evidence is gathered.
